mapper.select: SELECT * FROM att_checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND check_date = #{day} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att_checkin (user_id, check_date, check_in, in_status, location) VALUES (#{userId}, #{checkDate}, #{checkIn}, #{inStatus}, #{location})
mapper.update: UPDATE att_checkin SET check_out=#{time}, out_status=#{status}, work_hours=#{hours} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: FROM att_checkin c JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.check_date LIKE CONCAT(#{month}, '%')
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.real_name AS real_name, d.dept_name AS dept_name ORDER BY c.check_date DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.real_name AS real_name, d.dept_name AS dept_name, COUNT(*) AS days, SUM(CASE WHEN c.in_status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, SUM(CASE WHEN c.out_status = 'EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early, SUM(c.work_hours) AS hours FROM att_checkin c JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE c.check_date LIKE CONCAT(#{month}, '%') GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name, d.dept_name ORDER BY days DESC, late DESC
SELECT * FROM att_leave_balance WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND year_no = #{year}
mapper.update: UPDATE att_leave_balance SET annual_used = annual_used + #{days} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
